item1.title: NL2SQL Data Query Agent (Level 1)
item1.desc: The best entry point for Java devs transitioning to AI Agent. SpringBoot native — natural language input → AI generates SQL → safe execution → visualized reports. Master LLM API calls, Prompt engineering, 5-layer SQL security, and SSE streaming.

item3.title: Work Order Agent (Level 3)
item3.desc: Core project for enterprise OA/customer service/ops modernization. First introduction of lightweight RAG + intent recognition + business state machine. Pipeline: smart classification → entity extraction → auto-assignment → knowledge base retrieval → state machine flow → analytics.

item4.title: Code Review Agent (Level 4)

item5.title: Multi-Agent Collaboration System (Planning)
item5.desc: The watershed project bridging single-Agent to multi-agent cluster architecture. Orchestrator Agent as unified entry → intent parsing → task decomposition → dispatch to sub-agents (Data/Document/Approval/Retrieval) → result aggregation & conflict resolution. Master DAG task orchestration, Agent registry & discovery, serial dependency & parallel scheduling.

item6.title: Local Private RAG Knowledge Base (Planning)

project1.title: NL2SQL Data Query Agent — Level 1 Entry Point
project1.desc:
The AI Data Query Agent is an entry-level Java AI Agent designed to help developers deeply understand the three core principles: LLM reasoning, Tool Calling, and task orchestration.

Key features:
1) Hand-written core logic with no dependencies on heavy frameworks like LangChain;
2) Pure Java backend implementation, ideal for Spring Boot developers;
3) Clean, well-commented code structured as an ideal learning path.

Core flow: natural language query → LLM intent understanding → automatic tool selection → SQL/API query execution → result formatting → task completion. Adaptable as an enterprise data assistant or automated reporting system.

project2.title: API Inspection Agent — Level 2 Automation
project2.desc:
The API Inspection Agent is a Java-native automated API quality monitoring tool built with pure backend engineering architecture, free of heavy AI framework dependencies.

Core capabilities:
1) Batch API calls: scheduled concurrent invocation for RESTful/gRPC endpoints;
2) Smart assertions: AI-generated assertion rules covering status codes, response structure, and field types;
3) Exception handling & retry: automatic retry with fallback for timeouts and service unavailability;
4) AI root cause analysis: automatic log and error analysis on inspection failures;
5) Automated reports & alerts: multi-channel notifications via DingTalk, Feishu, or email.

Ready to serve as infrastructure for small to mid-size team API quality assurance.

project3.title: Work Order Agent — Level 3 Business Integration
project3.desc:
The Work Order Agent is a Java-native intelligent ticket management system built on backend engineering principles without heavy AI frameworks.

Core pipeline:
1) Smart classification: LLM-based identification of ticket type (bug, feature, inquiry, incident);
2) Entity extraction: key entities from ticket text (system, module, version, user);
3) Auto-assignment: automatic routing based on classification and entities;
4) Knowledge base Q&A: RAG-powered retrieval of similar cases and auto-generated response suggestions;
5) Complex workflows: multi-level approvals and cross-team collaboration;
6) Root cause analysis & post-mortems: incident tickets automatically correlated with monitoring data.

Production-ready for internal enterprise deployment as an intelligent work order system.

project4.title: Code Review Agent — Level 4 Vertical Deep Dive
project4.desc:
The Code Review Agent is the most advanced project in the series — a Java-native implementation with no heavy AI framework dependencies that achieves a fully automated code review pipeline.

Review pipeline:
1) Code intake: Git repos, PR diffs, code snippets via multiple input methods;
2) Syntax & style checks: AST-based Java code style analysis (naming, formatting, comments);
3) Semantic review: LLM-driven logic analysis for potential bugs, logic holes, and missing boundary conditions;
4) RAG-enhanced analysis: context-aware review using internal coding standards and best practice docs;
5) Vulnerability detection: OWASP Top 10 scanning for SQL injection, XSS, sensitive data exposure;
6) Performance analysis: N+1 queries, memory leaks, improper collection usage;
7) Code optimization: design pattern-based refactoring suggestions;
8) Structured reports: Markdown/HTML/PDF multi-format report output.

Replaces traditional manual code review with standardized, intelligent, automated processes.

project5.title: Multi-Agent Collaboration System — Level 5 Architecture
project5.desc:
The Multi-Agent Collaboration System is the watershed project bridging single-Agent development to multi-agent cluster architecture.

Core architecture:
1) Orchestrator Agent: unified task entry, intent recognition → task decomposition → sub-agent dispatch → result aggregation & conflict resolution;
2) Data Agent: NL2SQL queries + report statistics + trend analysis;
3) Document Agent: weekly report generation + notifications + document drafting;
4) Approval Agent: rule-based judgment + process approval + permission checks + compliance.

Technical highlights: DAG topology-based task orchestration engine supporting serial dependencies and parallel execution; pluggable Agent registration mechanism (interface + annotation based, new Agents just implement the interface); multi-user session isolation + task status tracking.

🔨 This project is under planning. Stay tuned.

project6.title: Local Private RAG Knowledge Base — Level 6 Capstone
project6.desc:
The Local Private RAG Knowledge Base is the ultimate capstone of the learning roadmap and the most valuable, core industrial AI deployment pattern.

Complete RAG Pipeline:
1) Document loading: PDF, Word, Markdown, TXT, HTML multi-format support;
2) Intelligent chunking: heading-aware + semantic boundary + configurable overlap window;
3) Vector storage: local SQLite + vector table / memory-mapped file approach;
4) Hybrid retrieval: BM25 keyword + vector semantic search + RRF weighted fusion;
5) Reranking: Cross-encoder / LLM Rerank fine ranking;
6) Answer generation: Prompt assembly + source citation + hallucination checking + streaming output.

System capabilities: supports Ollama + Qwen3-8B local model for fully offline operation with optional cloud model fallback; knowledge base CRUD + incremental index updates; multi-turn conversation context management.

🔨 This project is under planning. Stay tuned.

item2.title: Java RAG Framework

item3.title: LLM Tool Calling SDK

item4.title: API Auto Test Framework

item5.title: Smart Work Order Engine
item5.desc: An embeddable workflow engine core library featuring customizable process orchestration, conditional branching, parallel approvals, and SLA management, with built-in AI-driven ticket classification and recommendations.

item6.title: Code Quality Analyzer
item6.desc: A Java code quality analysis toolkit supporting AST-level inspections, cyclomatic complexity analysis, code smell detection, and auto-fix suggestions. Integrates into CI/CD pipelines as a quality gate.
